There is NO caller precondition on _libctx: it is bound with an underscore and the body never reads, compares, dereferences or forwards it, so NULL, dangling, unaligned or arbitrary values are all inert. The return value is either NULL (every failure arm) or a fully constructed, uniquely owned `RAND_GLOBAL` the caller becomes responsible for handing to the slot. `RawGlobal::new()` is a safe wrapper over `CRYPTO_zalloc(size_of::<RandGlobal>(), FILE, 513)`; it answers `Some(NonNull)` for a fresh, zeroed, correctly aligned, whole-block allocation or `None` for NULL (src/rand/rand_lib.rs:383-394).
